description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2510012941846 WINDOW,VEHICULAR: Line 0001 Qty 13 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0086 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
